name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes idle before compacting. The default of 50 leaves 10 minutes before a 1-hour prompt cache expires.

minTokens.title: Minimum conversation tokens
minTokens.description: Leave smaller conversations alone: re-reading them cold is cheap. The system prompt and tools don't count.

compactPromptFile.title: Compaction prompt file
compactPromptFile.description: A text file with the instructions for the summary, as you would give them to /compact. Leave empty for the built-in six-part continuation summary.
